subject: Data Engineering
title: Delta Lake Explained
description: A micro-lesson that makes Delta Lake Explained usable.

hook.text: Databricks open-sourced Delta Lake in 2019. It brought ACID transactions to data lakes for the first time.

buildup.text: Delta Lake stores data as Parquet files plus a transaction log that tracks every change to the table.

discovery.text: The transaction log enables ACID commits, time travel, schema enforcement, and efficient upserts.

twist.text: Delta Lake is tightly integrated with Spark and Databricks. Using it outside that ecosystem requires more effort.

climax.text: Delta Lake proved that lakes could be reliable. It sparked an entire movement toward open table formats.

punchline.text: Parquet plus a transaction log. That's the Delta Lake magic.

quiz.question: How does Delta Lake add ACID transactions to a data lake?
options: By adding a transaction log on top of Parquet files
By replacing Parquet with a new format
By copying data into a hidden database
